learning: Iteration 9 showed the drivetrain lever still gives a gain (s-bend 0.1604 to 0.1675) while oscillation sits near 0.157 to 0.159. Oscillation follows effective turn gain, so kp must scale with 1/wheel_track. The next race decides whether to keep narrowing, revert, or stop changing geometry.
notes: Complete package for the Builder's wheel_track 0.085 m step. kp is lowered from 4.6 to 4.2 so effective turn gain stays near the iteration 9 level and slalom oscillation stays below the 0.16 trigger.
rationale: Iteration 9 (wheel_track 0.09 m, kp 4.6) lifted s-bend progress to 0.1675 and the oval to 0.174, with slalom and s-bend steering_oscillation at 0.157 and 0.159, both just under the 0.16 trigger. Oscillation tracks effective turn gain (kp divided by wheel_track). Iteration 8 (kp 5.0, 0.10 m) and iteration 9 had similar gain and similar oscillation, so kp alone barely changed it. Following the Builder's requested step, I set wheel_track 0.085 m. Turn gain then rises about 6 percent at equal kp, so I lower kp to 4.2 (gain about 49, slightly under iteration 9's 51) to keep oscillation from reaching 0.16. Sensing, forward offset y = 0.08 m, mass 0.8 kg and radius 0.03 m stay as in iteration 9, so the race isolates the track width. Expected: s-bend progress about 0.17 and slalom oscillation about 0.155 to 0.16. These are predictions, not measurements. The line-loss recovery, base speed, ki and kd are unchanged.
